title: Cluster report
description: What Clarence found in the cluster at its last daily report: vulnerable images, images Renovate does not track, volumes without a backup or in no use, and blocked re-vendors. Replaces the daily report issue.

panels.title: Vulnerable images
panels.description: Running images with a known CVE. 'with a fix' counts those where a fixed version of at least one CVE is out (fixable is not 0).

panels.title: Unscanned images
panels.description: Running images the scanner has no result for.

panels.title: Untracked images
panels.description: Running images no Renovate dependency covers, so nothing proposes their updates.

panels.title: Renovate lookup failures
panels.description: Dependencies Renovate failed to look up. They never get update pull requests until fixed.

panels.title: Unbacked volumes
panels.description: Volumes no kopiur SnapshotPolicy backs up.

panels.title: Unused volumes
panels.description: Volumes no running pod mounts any more.

panels.title: Report age
panels.description: Time since the last report run. The report runs daily, so over 26 hours means it is not running.

panels.title: Unread sources
panels.description: Sources the last report run could not read. The numbers on this dashboard are stale or missing for them.

panels.title: Sources the last run could not read
panels.description: The report retries a run with an unread source every 10 minutes. Absent while everything was read.

panels.title: Running images by scan result
panels.description: Every running image: vulnerable, clean or unscanned.

panels.title: Vulnerable images
panels.description: Running images with a CVE, worst first (fixable CRITICAL, then fixable). 'Newer tag' says what a newer tag fixes, or why there is none. Rows Clarence first saw in the last 24 hours are marked new.

targets.expr: max by (image, namespaces, cves, newer, fixable, fixable_critical) (clarence_vulnerable_image{service="clarence-home-ops"}) * 1000
time() - max by (image, namespaces, cves, newer, fixable, fixable_critical) (clarence_vulnerable_image{service="clarence-home-ops"}) < bool 86400

panels.title: Renovate dashboard
panels.description: What Renovate's dependency dashboard issue lists. When Renovate cut its detected list short, an untracked image below may be tracked after all.

true.text: Truncated: untracked images below may be tracked after all

panels.title: Untracked images
panels.description: Running images no Renovate dependency covers. 'Tracked versions' lists other versions of the same repository the Renovate dashboard has. Newest first; rows first seen in the last 24 hours are marked new.

targets.expr: time() - max by (image, repo, namespaces, tracked) (clarence_untracked_image{service="clarence-home-ops"}) < bool 86400

panels.title: Lookup failures
panels.description: Dependencies Renovate could not look up, and the files that use them.

panels.title: Held updates
panels.description: Updates Renovate found but is not opening, with the section of its dashboard they sit in and why.

panels.title: Unbacked volumes
panels.description: Volumes no kopiur SnapshotPolicy backs up, largest first. Rows first seen in the last 24 hours are marked new.

targets.expr: time() - max by (pvc, app, storage_class, size_bytes) (clarence_unbacked_volume{service="clarence-home-ops"}) < bool 86400

panels.title: Unused volumes
panels.description: Volumes no running pod mounts, longest unused first. 'Last used' is when a pod last mounted the volume; when no pod names it at all, it is when Clarence first saw it that way (see Basis).

targets.expr: max by (pvc, app, storage_class, size_bytes, from_pod) (clarence_unused_volume{service="clarence-home-ops"}) * 1000

false.text: No pod names it; first seen so

panels.title: Blocked vendored-manifest updates
panels.description: Upstream released a version of a vendored manifest whose changes collide with local edits, so no pull request was opened. Usually empty.

targets.expr: max by (file, repo, from, to, conflicts) (clarence_vendor_blocked{service="clarence-home-ops"}) * 1000
